miriel_intro.speaker: miriel
miriel_intro.text: Voidweaver. You arrive at a delicate juncture. House Corvane's succession charter has been stolen from our private gallery, and my cousin Valen intends to present a forged codicil to the Conclave before the midnight watch.

start_quest.title: A House Divided
start_quest.desc: Navigate an inheritance dispute and covert saboteur plot within House Corvane's high manse.
stages: Confer with Lady Miriel in the Corvane Upper Manse

choices.text: [Magnetism Check] Lady Miriel, if we bring this before the Conclave without ironclad proof, the other Houses will use it to divide Corvane's voting bloc.
[Acumen Check] Let me examine the wax seal on the registry copy. True Corvane wax contains crushed starlight quartz.
What does Valen hope to gain by forcing a succession crisis now?

miriel_explain.speaker: miriel
miriel_explain.text: Control of our rim observatory! He wants to redirect our stellar lenses toward the void border, defying the Common Sky covenant.

choices.text: Then we must recover the true charter before the vote.

miriel_magnetism_pass.speaker: miriel
miriel_magnetism_pass.text: You speak with the wisdom of a diplomat, Elorin. If we confront Valen privately with the Archmagister's backing, he will have no choice but to yield.

choices.text: Let us present the evidence to Valen in closed chambers.

miriel_magnetism_fail.speaker: miriel
miriel_magnetism_fail.text: I care nothing for Conclave politics! My grandfather's legacy is being rewritten by a traitor in our own bloodline!

choices.text: Then let us find the document before he can present it.

miriel_acumen_pass.speaker: miriel
miriel_acumen_pass.text: Brilliant! The seal on his document is common resin tinted with copper shavings. Under a lantern, the fraud is undeniable.

choices.text: Expose the fraudulent seal to the house elders.

miriel_resolve.speaker: miriel
miriel_resolve.text: Valen has withdrawn his claim in disgrace. House Corvane stands united, and our observatory remains dedicated to the safeguard. Take this signet as our gratitude.
